criteria.name: Architecture et séparation des responsabilités
criteria.description: Layering, separation of responsibilities (UI / business logic / infrastructure), coupling between packages, cohesion of classes, relevance of design patterns.

criteria.name: Lisibilité du code
criteria.description: Naming, method length, comments, consistent style, absence of dead code and magic numbers.

criteria.name: Gestion des exceptions
criteria.description: Appropriate exception types, no swallowed exceptions (empty catch), meaningful messages, resources closed (try-with-resources), no catch of generic Exception without reason.

criteria.name: Respect des principes SOLID
criteria.description: Single responsibility, open/closed, Liskov substitution, interface segregation, dependency inversion (depending on abstractions).

criteria.name: Sécurité
criteria.description: Hard-coded secrets, injection risks (SQL, command, path), unsafe deserialization, input validation, sensitive data in logs.

criteria.name: Présence et qualité apparente des tests
criteria.description: Deterministic count of test files, test methods and assertions.

criteria.name: Documentation
criteria.description: README content and Javadoc coverage of public types.

criteria.name: Qualité du Dockerfile
criteria.description: Pinned base image, non-root user, multi-stage build, no secrets, .dockerignore.

criteria.name: Compilation et tests en bac à sable
criteria.description: Builds and runs the tests of the project inside an isolated Docker container (no network).
